title: Measurability of the multiplicity and of the pushed-forward orientation (parent Step 1)
statement: Let P, Q, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, (M, θ, ξ) with IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ, and L : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^Q) Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable. Then θ is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. measurable, and x ↦ L(x)_#ξ(x) = nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x) is Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → AEStronglyMeasurable L ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) → AEMeasurable θ ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x)) ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M)
